We have window tinting stores located conveniently throu4ghout Australia, including Newcastle. Our window tinting Newcastle services include car, home and office window tinting.Below, discover the benefits of home window tinting in Newcastle and why it is such a great investment.

For 50 years Tint a Home has been providing tinting services in Australia. All films in our range are exclusive to us (supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world) and are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications, which are done by professionally trained installers. We also have an interest free payment option available. Here are the benefits of home window tinting Newcastle

Mobile Window Tinting Newcastle

With our mobile window tinting in Newcastle, a consultant will come out to your home to do a free measure and quote. We have a range of films to choose from including solar films, safety & security films, privacy films and decorative films. Your consultant can provide recommendations on the best films to use in different areas of your home.

Depending on the film or films you choose, here are some of the benefits of tinting your home windows:

  • Your home will be cooler in summer and warmer in winter so you can enjoy a more comfortable temperature all year round
  • Energy efficiency (window tint acts as a layer of insulation on your windows – this makes a positive difference to your power bills too!)
  • A reduction in glare (you’ll notice reflections on screens are minimised)
  • Protection for you and your family from the damage caused by harmful UV rays
  • Increased safety with a film that holds shattered glass together in the event of it being broken
  • A more secure home with a film that makes it harder for unwanted visitors to gain access
  • A reduction in premature fading of flooring and furnishings
